clue.text: Weight man brought into contact with foot

parts.note: the pronoun he stands for a man
ft is the standard abbreviation for foot as a measure

explanation.surface: A heavy man's foot is brought down in a contact sport.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought into contact with' simply sets the two pieces side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: Heft is a noun for heaviness or bulk, a synonym of weight.

clue.text: What-ho! galloping, covering kilometre to get nocturnal creature

indicators.note: covering means the rearranged letters wrap around the abbreviation
galloping suggests wild movement, so the letters of the exclamation are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rider shouts and gallops a kilometre to catch a night animal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'galloping' rearranges WHATHO into HAWOTH, and 'covering' puts KM inside: HAW(KM)OTH.
explanation.definitionFit: This large moth flies at dusk and after dark, so it is a creature of the night.

clue.text: What makes a name copyright in part of the film industry?

clue.text: Business organisation info initially captured in a year

indicators.note: initially takes only the opening letter of the word captured

explanation.definitionFit: An agency is a firm providing a service, such as a travel or advertising business.

clue.text: Hardly a theatre's coming attraction!

parts.note: a 'coming attraction' is a show advertised as on its way; here it is a play whose title figure famously never arrives on stage

explanation.surface: A grumble that the next show at the theatre looks dull.
explanation.walkthrough: In Beckett's play the two tramps wait for someone who never comes, so the play is literally not a 'coming' attraction.
explanation.definitionFit: Beckett's play centres on a character who never turns up, so it is the theatre piece about nobody coming.

clue.text: Seed where one's replaced 'pea 'with 'form of ape'?

parts.words: Seed where one's replaced 'pea 'with 'form of ape'?
parts.note: take the familiar name of the groundnut and swap its first three letters, the legume, for a kind of primate

explanation.surface: A botanist renames a seed by swapping a vegetable for an ape.
explanation.walkthrough: The groundnut is usually called a peanut; put a monkey in place of the pea and you have its other name.
explanation.definitionFit: The groundnut, eaten roasted in its shell, is also sold under this name, so it is the seed described.

clue.text: Votes against having no time for comments

explanation.definitionFit: Something inelastic cannot stretch or give, so it is rigid.

clue.text: English friend filling in returning Asian

indicators.note: filling means the following pieces go inside the reversed short word
returning tells the solver to read the little word in from right to left

parts.note: pal is an informal word for a friend

explanation.surface: An English friend comes back home to Asia to fill in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns IN into NI, and 'filling' puts E + PAL inside it: N(EPAL)I.
explanation.definitionFit: A person from Nepal is an Asian, since Nepal lies in the Himalayas.

explanation.definitionFit: The Pyrenees are the range separating France from Spain.

clue.text: Recipe needs stuff for frying — step back!

oil is what food is fried in

clue.text: Trainee left with employee

parts.note: an earner is someone in paid work

clue.text: Entrance in knowing style

way means manner or style

clue.text: Wonder about most of mountain for some time

clue.text: How E major piece often ends, stupid

explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer as IN AN E for the musical reading.

clue.text: Jack, say, had to go under vehicle

clue.text: Canteen showing extremes of meagreness
